❇️ Armed individual arrested after Baran Foundation meeting; possible assassination attempt on Abbas Akhoundi under investigation🔺Following a specialized meeting of the Baran Foundation at the National Library complex, an armed individual was arrested who, according to initial reports, intended to assassinate Dr. Abbas Akhoundi.◾️The meeting featured a speech by Dr. Abbas Akhoundi on "Global Transitions, Value Chains, and Iran's Development Architecture." According to information received, after the event ended and as Dr. Akhoundi was leaving, an armed individual got into a confrontation with his driver. During the confrontation, the driver managed to wrest the weapon from the attacker's hand, and subsequently, with the intervention of security personnel and law enforcement, the individual was arrested.◾️The arrested individual is said to have claimed ties to another group during the incident, stating that even if he is arrested, others will carry out the act. According to available reports, he also named several other figures as possible assassination targets.◾️Based on initial information, a report of the incident has been sent to the relevant authorities. Further details about the identity of the arrested individual, his motive, and the possible dimensions of this matter have not yet been officially announced.🔹Find the Iran Reform Front on social media: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)

❇️ Seyyed Mohammad Khatami: The voice of dialogue, peace, and sustainable security has created new hopes in the world

🔻Seyyed Mohammad Khatami, head of the Reform Government, in the continuation of his statement, referring to the consequences of America's policies and recent aggressions, wrote:

▪️The commission of the greatest crimes and the most heinous violations of international law, and the trampling of the rights of the Iranian nation with the complicity of the anti-human Israeli regime in recent years and in open aggressions, bears witness to this claim. The dismembered bodies of 170 elementary school children, thousands of innocent citizens, and the most prominent leaders, scientists, commanders, and children who served — amid the continuation and expansion of cruel sanctions and inhumane sieges — what do they mean? And against all this, what name do they give to the epic resistance of the people and the defenders of the homeland?

▪️Of course, we must recognize that this ear-piercing voice of the American government, though loud, is not the true voice of the American people and elites, nor the voice of the order of the progressive world.

▪️The voice of dialogue, peace, sustainable security, and all-round development is a voice that, although still not easily heard in the world of politics, has created new hopes in the human world; the voice of defending the oppressed people of Gaza, the voice of rejection, isolation, and condemnation of Israel, and the voice of the collapse of the credibility and authority of the President of the United States has now become so widespread that it cannot be denied.

▪️The coherent picture that the President of China recently draws of the necessities facing the world is another proof of this claim. In China's view, the four main issues of humanity — development and technology, peace and security, dialogue of civilizations, and reform of global governance — are inseparable from one another.

🔹The address of the Iran Reform Front on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)

❇️ Spokesman of the Iran Reform Front: Preventing war must be the decision-makers' first red line 🔺Javad Imam, spokesman of the Iran Reform Front, warning of the danger of war against Iran, emphasized: Preventing war must be the country's decision-makers' first "red line," and every avenue of negotiation, diplomacy, and de-escalation must be exhausted to the very last possibility.◾️The spokesman of the Iran Reform Front wrote in a post on the X social network: "The danger of war against Iran must not be underestimated; preventing war must be the decision-makers' first red line."◾️Noting that it is the decision-makers who decide to start or enter a war, but the people who pay its costs, he added: "If war breaks out, it is the people who pay its price with their lives, security, homes, and livelihood."◾️The spokesman of the Iran Reform Front, stating that "no political, security, or military calculation should take precedence over people's lives," emphasized: "Before any irreversible decision, every avenue of negotiation, diplomacy, and de-escalation must be tested to the very last possibility."◾️Javad Imam continued, clarifying that although it is America and Israel who would start the war, he noted: "The responsibility for preventing its expansion and the cost of ending it cannot be ignored; it is the people who pay the price of war."◾️In conclusion, emphasizing the position of "No to war," he deemed it essential to prioritize the preservation of people's lives and security and to use diplomatic capacities to prevent the expansion of the conflict.🔹The Iran Reform Front's address on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)

❇️ Summoning of the Secretary of the Iran Reform Front to the Security Prosecutor's Office

🔺 Badr al-Sadat Mofidi, Secretary of the Iran Reform Front, appeared today at Branch 2 of the Security Prosecutor's Office of District 33, and after interrogation and presentation of final defenses, was released on bail.

◾️ The summoning of the Secretary of the Iran Reform Front comes as part of the ongoing process of summoning and filing cases against members of the Front's Board of Directors. This case concerns the Iran Reform Front's statement about the catastrophe of 18 and 19 Dey, which was published in Bahman of last year.

◾️ In that statement, the Iran Reform Front, while expressing sympathy and solidarity with the grieving people of Iran, emphasized the need for fundamental, urgent, and serious changes and a reconsideration of past approaches, and declared that reformist efforts to have reforms recognized as part of the solution have reached a dead end.

◾️ The formation of an independent fact-finding committee to investigate the various dimensions of this catastrophe, as well as the formation of a national assembly bringing together all elites and concerned citizens of the country to find ways out of the existing crises, were among the proposals put forward in this statement.

◾️ The issuance of this statement was met with a reaction from security and judicial bodies and the summoning of a number of members of the Board of Directors of the Iran Reform Front — a process that continues with the summoning of the Front's Secretary.

🔹The Iran Reform Front's address on social networks: Telegram, Instagram, X (Twitter)
